findings.description: `active_skus` is built as a list, so `scan.sku not in active_skus` scans the list for every scan. With a large catalog and many scans (a typical stocktake) this is O(scans × skus) and will be slow.
findings.suggestion: Build a set: `active_skus = {item.sku for item in catalog.active()}`.
findings.title: Linear list membership test inside scan loop gives quadratic cost
